description: Fictional places for fixture mode. Street and town names are invented; states are real so the climate table applies. Coordinates are synthetic, placed in large public lands or open water, and are never geocoded from a real address. No place depicts a real home.

conventions.placeId: Places-style identifiers (27 characters, ChIJ prefix); stable across runs.
conventions.addressComponents: Places API (New) shape: longText, shortText, types, languageCode.
conventions.geocode: Geocoding API signals: locationType (ROOFTOP, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, GEOMETRIC_CENTER, APPROXIMATE) and partialMatch.
conventions.destinations: SearchDestinations-shaped signals. structureType BUILDING with hasOutline true means geometry is available (heading mode geometry); facadeNormalDeg is the compass direction the facade faces.
conventions.metadataStatus: Street View metadata status at this place: OK when panoramas exist, ZERO_RESULTS when there is no imagery within 200 m (also used where discovery never reaches metadata), UNKNOWN_ERROR when every metadata call fails, including the one retry.
conventions.panoramas: At most 3. The first is the probe at the target point; offsets are probes displaced along the road. distanceM and headingDeg are computed with the haversine distance and initial great-circle bearing from the panorama location to destinations.targetPoint. captureDate is YYYY-MM, YYYY or null; copyright credits the licensed fixture photograph ("Fixture photo: <photographer> / <license>"); a copyright ending "(contributor imagery stand-in)" stands in for contributor imagery, any other fixture photo for first-party imagery.
conventions.manualEntry: A typed address resolves to a place when its normalized line 1 (and line 2 for units) equals one of geocodeAliases. Normalization: Unicode NFD with diacritics removed, lowercase, every character other than a-z, 0-9, # and space replaced by a space, whitespace collapsed. When city, state or ZIP differ from manualEntry the candidate is returned with partialMatch true. No match returns no candidates (ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND).
conventions.scenario: match is the discovery outcome for the autocomplete path (manual entry is capped at confirm); reason is set for skip_to_upload; render is the render scenario used for jobs whose source comes from this place.
conventions.photo: Every panorama shows a licensed real photograph from content/photos/manifest.json (photoId), panned and zoomed to the requested view: the reference view (heading to the target, fov from the facade width and distance, pitch from the distance) frames the photo's houseFacade box; heading offsets shift the crop horizontally, pitch vertically and fov sets its size. framing scales the reference framing (more surroundings above 1) and shiftX / shiftY offset it as fractions of its size. blurredHouse blurs the whole target facade (owner-requested blur). Anchors come from the manifest, transformed into the frame. Panoramas may instead carry procedural house parameters for the SVG renderer (tests only).
